scope: Synthetic native EventLoop consumes one transplanted queue request, then an explicit host Mesa bridge initializes, updates and draws the selected renderer. The native canvas getter computes Matrix4 from a host-adapted observed Matrix3 and fabricated screen bitmap before the explicit draw; this does not establish automatic paint, normal scheduling, saved-page or device behavior.
list: Native ordered list dispatch, supplied Matrix3 and 84 AddPoint calls asserted by adapter
runtime_limitations: Host EGL, GLES, Mesa drivers and transitive shared libraries are unpinned.
worker: Submission, queue entry sequence, worker cleanup and empty sentinel asserted by the worker adapter; bitmap, context, locks and destructor remain synthetic.
